name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing window trim?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between repairing and replacing window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing window trim involves fixing existing damage, such as filling cracks, sanding, painting, or replacing small, localized sections. The goal is to restore the trim's appearance and function without a complete overhaul. Replacing window trim, on the other hand, means removing the entire existing trim piece and installing a new one. Replacement is typically chosen when the damage is too extensive for repair, when upgrading materials for better durability, or during a larger window replacement project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repairing fixes existing damage to restore appearance, while replacing involves removing and installing entirely new trim, usually for extensive damage or upgrades.
